text:
oncall-bot: P1 ALERT — continuous-batcher service in us-east-1. Sudden latency spike >95th pct, multiple container restarts observed, paging #eng-oncall. logs: https://internal.logs/redwood/runtime/batcher/4818889999 :rotating_light:

sam: seeing queue depth ramping for the last 3m, tail RTs 10-20s now. batch size trending up steadily, not saturating GPU but KV cache keeps growing.

lina: confirmed container crash traces include repeated CUDA OOMs on gpu-3. kernel stack shows device allocations failing during prefetch. cpu/mem on host look fine.

mike: attaching recent stderr snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T18:26:10Z] runtime: alloc failed on device 3: CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY
[2026-03-15T18:26:10Z] continuous_batcher: trying to grow accumulator -> new length 16384
[2026-03-15T18:26:10Z] prefetcher: kv_cache size 54.2GB, threshold 48GB
[2026-03-15T18:26:12Z] container: exit code 137
```

irene: adding context — we rolled quantized-2.1 last night to improve perf. Early hypothesis: prefetch + new quant kernels causing memory accounting drift -> runaway accumulator growth.

devops: node ops — gpu-3 on node i-0a1b2c3d flapped (nvlink resets). We can drain node and move traffic, but capacity in region is tight.

sam: customer impact? any 504s or user-facing errors?

cust-success-bot: 4 customers reporting latency >10s (session ids redacted). One support ticket from AcmeCorp with timeouts on their chat flow. CS triage assigned to Natalie.

natalie: pinged AcmeCorp, told them we're investigating and putting mitigations in place. Asking if they can tolerate degraded throughput for now.

chris: quick mitigation idea: enable strict-batch-cap config to cap accumulator at 512 per model, and fallback to CPU-quantized model if device alloc fails. That should stop growth.

lina: agree. We need whitelist so rollout just affects us-east-1 continuous-batcher. Also want to disable prefetcher KV growth for this model.

mike: commands to apply (will run once we have ack):
```bash
# limit accumulator
redwoodctl set-config continuous-batcher --region us-east-1 --model quantized-2.1 --accumulator-max 512
# turn off prefetch
redwoodctl set-config continuous-batcher --region us-east-1 --model quantized-2.1 --prefetch-enabled false
```

sam: if we cap accumulator, what latency change do we expect?

chris: should bring 95th from 10-20s back to ~1.2s while slightly increasing per-request compute. Tradeoff: higher per-token cost but avoids OOM.

devops: draining node i-0a1b2c3d now, starting cordon/evict. This will trigger more restarts but avoids repeated nvlink resets. ETA 90s.

oncall-bot: deploy-bot initiated config change request by chris. CI gating: none (runtime config). Waiting for operator confirmation to apply.

lina: i'll apply the config changes now, mike can watch logs.

mike: ready. tailing logs.

lina: applied accumulator-max=512 and prefetch-enabled=false for quantized-2.1 in us-east-1.

mike: logs: accumulator growth arrested, kv_cache stabilizing at 32GB, no new OOMs for 2m. tail 95th down to 1.8s then 1.3s.

sam: nice. any residual errors?

lina: one container killed during node drain (expected), auto-restarted on another host. no further device errors.

cust-success-bot: updated AcmeCorp: "We've implemented temporary mitigations to stabilize latency; your requests should be returning normally. We'll follow up with permanent fix timeline."

natalie: AcmeCorp replied: appreciated quick action, some brief errors during drain but overall recovery.

chris: plan for next steps: 1) create a canary rollout of quantized-2.1 with prefetch disabled and accumulator cap by default; 2) reproduce locally with stress harness to debug allocator accounting; 3) longer-term: add hard guard on accumulator growth and early reject/429 when prefetch memory pressure crosses threshold.

sam: who owns postmortem? recommend Lina + Runtime team + DevOps; set Sev owner to Lina.

lina: happy to own postmortem. I'll include reproducer, timeline, and proposed fixes.

devops: file created: INC-2026-03-15-8472. I'll attach node-level metrics and nvlink logs.

oncall-bot: paging handoff reminder: if this persists after 2h escalate to Eng-Platform lead.

mike: follow-up note: earlier version of the prefetcher lacked backpressure on kv_cache growth; adding a circuit-breaker that rejects prefetch when memory > 70% solves the runaway scenario in local sim.

lina: adding that to backlog — hotfix to add circuit-breaker + metric (prefetch_rejects) and alert.

chris: also add a dashboard tile with accumulator length histogram so we can alert on growth slope rather than absolute value.

sam: thanks everyone. marking thread for incident follow-up. if anything regresses, re-open page. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Incident resolved -> status: partial-mitigated. Root-cause: prefetch + quantized-2.1 allocator accounting bug -> accumulator growth -> CUDA OOM -> container restarts -> node drain triggered customer-visible latency.

lina: assigning owners for action items: lin a (postmortem + repro) , chris (dc guardrail + dashboard), mike (observability), devops (node health automation).

natalie: CS note: I'll send an incident summary and shared timeline to affected customers by EOD.

sam: closing thread, will link postmortem when ready.
